lessons.story:
SMALL STORY COMPETITION: Write an original fictional story of 120 to 180 words. Entries must be in English and submitted by one student, not a team. Give your story a title; the title does not count toward the word limit.

Submit through the school form by five on Friday. A saved draft is not an entry. Press 'Submit' and check for a confirmation number. If no number appears, ask the library desk for help before the deadline.

You may revise a submitted story before the deadline using the same confirmation number. Only the latest submitted version will be judged. Do not create another entry to replace the first, because each student may enter only once.

Judges will consider clear meaning, an engaging story, and effective use of language. A complicated plot is not required. The winning entries will be displayed with the writers' permission. Taking part allows judging, but public display will require a separate agreement.
lessons.title: The Small Story Competition
